findings.heading: ### Column width / 列の幅
findings.proposition: English states that finding the right value for width() takes trial and error ("It can take some playing around to know what width value to put"); the Japanese sentence goes straight from "you can specify widths with width()" to the example and omits this.
findings.reader_consequence: A Japanese reader expects a single correct width value and may treat a badly laid out table as an error in their code rather than as a value to adjust by iterating.

findings.heading: ## Resources / 参考資料
findings.proposition: English gives the full flextable book URL as https://ardata-fr.github.io/flextable-book/; the Japanese line reads "こちら://ardata-fr.github.io/flextable-book/", where the scheme has been overwritten by the word こちら, so no usable URL for the book is present.
findings.reader_consequence: A Japanese reader cannot reach the full flextable book: the text is not a link and pasting it into a browser fails, so the primary reference of the section is lost.

findings.heading: ### Print table in R markdown / R マークダウンで表を出力
findings.proposition: English points the reader to the Reports with R Markdown page with a working target, [Reports with R Markdown](rmarkdown.qmd); the Japanese link has an empty target, [R Markdown で作るレポート](), so the cross-reference resolves to nothing.
findings.reader_consequence: A Japanese reader clicking the only pointer to the detailed R Markdown material goes nowhere and cannot find the chapter the section defers to.

findings.heading: ### Save single table / 単一のテーブルとして保存
findings.proposition: English opens the paragraph by stating what the following chunk does: "For instance below we save our table as a word document." The Japanese paragraph starts at the note about the first argument and never states that the example saves the table as a Word document.
findings.reader_consequence: A Japanese reader meets the save_as_docx() example with no statement of what it produces, and must infer the output format from the function name and the file extension.

findings.heading: ## All code together / すべてのコードをまとめる
findings.proposition: The two vline() calls use j = 2 and j = 5, which select columns; the English comments read "# at column 2" and "# at column 5", but the Japanese comments read "# 2行目" and "# 5行目", which say row 2 and row 5. The same two calls are annotated correctly as 2列目 / 5列目 earlier in the same Japanese file (lines 86-87 and 323-324).
findings.reader_consequence: A Japanese reader copying the combined code block learns that j = specifies a row, which is the opposite of what the chapter teaches, and will pass row numbers to j = when adapting the code.

findings.heading: ### Load packages / パッケージの読み込み
findings.proposition: The Japanese adds the sentence "以下のコードを実行すると、分析に必要なパッケージが読み込まれます。" (running the code below loads the packages needed for the analysis), which has no counterpart in the English paragraph.
findings.reader_consequence: Minor: the Japanese reader is told the chunk loads every package the analysis needs, a claim the English does not make; it is correct here but is content the source does not carry.
